text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with Gold 
City for a change of pace.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer. Wanna make a little detour?
choice_data_list: All that's left is to go home, but...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...I see.
choice_data_list: Is there somewhere you want to stop by?
Is there somewhere you'd like to stop by?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Nothing in particular. That's why I 
asked."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
After school, on the way to work in my 
manager's car, I sometimes pass by 
Umamusume in their school uniforms.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I could hear those kids' voices through 
the window. Saying, "Our detour starts 
now!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It was already evening, so there couldn't 
have been many places open anyway. That's 
why there's no way it was "just getting 
started."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...They sounded like they were having so 
much fun, I couldn't get their voices out 
of my head even after arriving at the 
studio.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hm? If it ain't City. You guys heading out 
too?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Inari-senpai. No. I was actually 
just about to head back.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Gah!? You're leavin' already!? The 
festival's only just gettin' started!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What a waste... Jeez, just follow me! I'll 
show ya how to spend your time from here 
on out.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh? But...
choice_data_list:
Since we're here, let's learn the art of 
taking detours from our senpai!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh. Looks like you know your stuff too, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Shall we go, then, City! Time is money. 
We're running full speed ahead!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wait, if you do that, won't Trainer 
be unable to keep up...?
choice_data_list:
For now, let's just meet up at the 
destination.
Go have fun with your fellow students.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Well, if that's the case, then alright.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh, why the long face? Do you really want 
to be with your Trainer that much?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: N-No, that's not it! I'm not a kid, so...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Haha, but if you're gonna have fun, 
everyone oughta join in, no doubt about 
it. Especially when it comes to watching 
races!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? But it's a weekday at this hour, you 
know? Tokyo Racecourse is...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Get outta here! Don't you dare go sayin' 
you forgot about such an important 
racecourse!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ! Incred...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Haha, powerful stuff, isn't it? Here at 
Ohi, both the dust and the fighting spirit 
really fly.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
By the way, are you on this "Umasta" thing 
too?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Umastagram? If it's about that...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oho, then shall we go take some photos? 
There's a spot Falco's been oddly 
insistent about.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Falco-senpai did...? Then is it 
something that looks good in photos? Fufu, 
Jordan might react to it too.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
By the way, there's a lot of interesting 
food around too. Care to take a peek at 
the shops?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Here I go, here I go!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Wait! Hold on a second! The paddock for 
the next race is about to start too!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, what do I do! Which one should we go 
see first!? I seriously can't decide~!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Haha, what an innocent young lady. Looks 
like she's having a grand old time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"With gleaming eyes, Gold City was 
frolicking like a child."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Now that's stylish, Trainer. You sure 
know how to enjoy an after-school detour, 
don'tcha?"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
No grownups around after school! Hanging 
out with just fellow students is what 
makes it fun, right?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Still.
choice_data_list: Just let me know when you're heading back.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Right, City? Don't let that fighting 
spirit go to waste. Go on, get moving, get 
moving!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And after parting ways with Gold City, 
while finishing up my shopping in the 
shopping district—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ah. Trainer. Are you heading home now too?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! First we went to the arcade, and 
after that we drank honey drinks. Then 
next we went to the public bathhouse, and—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you're getting way too excited. 
Look, even the Trainer is surprised by 
your unusual burst of energy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gold City's cheeks are flushed. It looks 
like she had quite an enjoyable detour.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Did that fresh-out-of-the-bath beauty 
totally sweep you off your feet?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I'm saying you were totally 
mesmerized. By her completely relaxed 
smile, that is.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, Senpai, what are you talking 
about!?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, what are you panicking on your 
own for? Right in front of your Trainer, 
you've got a freshly bathed beauty like me 
right here!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"...Or what? Did you mistakenly think you 
were the only one they fell for?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Guh...! Inari-senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Inari One laughed heartily, Gold City's 
face flushed bright red.
